words.sense: Reach a particular conclusion by logically applying a general rule or established facts.
misconceptions: Assuming repeated observations logically guarantee a general rule.
Ignoring whether a general policy was known before the particular case.

words.sense: Infer a broader general pattern or rule from particular observations.
misconceptions: Ignoring whether a general policy was known before the particular case.

semantic_axes.description: Deduce applies a rule or established facts to a specific case; induce forms a general rule from particular examples.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Yasmine reached her conclusion?

beats.text: The rule says every red-tagged locker must be emptied; Yasmine saw hers had a red tag, so she knew it must be emptied.
beats.decisive_clue: applied a general rule to her specific locker
beats.reason: Applied a general rule to her specific locker. Specific conclusion from general rule.

beats.text: She checked that no exceptions applied to her locker.
beats.decisive_clue: checking exceptions strengthens rule-based conclusion
beats.reason: Checking exceptions strengthens rule-based conclusion. Specific conclusion from general rule.

chains.feedback_short: Checking exceptions strengthens rule-based conclusion makes deduce the better fit.
chains.feedback_deep: Deduce means reach a particular conclusion by logically applying a general rule or established facts; induce means infer a broader general pattern or rule from particular observations. Here, checking exceptions strengthens rule-based conclusion; that is why deduce wins even after the new detail.
chains.contrast_rule: Deduce goes rule to case; induce goes cases to rule.
